_comment: Authority for what may run concurrently. The scheduler reads this file;
it never asks a model whether two nodes conflict.
JSON, not YAML, on purpose: the supervisor runs under launchd on the system
python3 with no venv and no network, and requirements.txt carries no PyYAML.
A scheduler that cannot start because a parser is missing is the exact failure
mode this system exists to remove. To switch to YAML, add PyYAML to
requirements.txt and change load_ownership() in ops/schedule.py.

assembly_only._comment: Written by the N0/assembly node alone, never by a work node.

Tier 2 because it is the credential path to a live provider call, even though it never touched integrations/meta.py. Tier follows blast radius, not directory. docs/evidence/meta-live.md is additionally Tier 3: only a real credential-backed run may change its verdict.
No node may claim these as owns without an explicit Tier 2 work order naming them.
The scheduler may not rewrite its own rules from inside a worker.
Physical device. Read-only Pi inspection is Tier 1; any write to the Pi is Tier 3 and needs per-session human authorization.
Corpus and invariants. The adversary that writes cases must not be the agent that wrote the defence; record generator.model and generator.sees_implementation on every artefact.
QIP. Section 11 amendment procedure applies; a work node may not promote its own requirement to tested.
Isolated workspace. Raising the root Rust MSRV would make it Tier 2.

Figures, animations and video are GENERATED from committed evidence files, never hand-authored. Every artefact embeds its source path, that source's sha256, the commit and the UTC time, plus an evidence band: MEASURED-ON-HOST, SIMULATED, SYNTHETIC, or NOT TESTED. No visual may depict a capability whose QIP status is UNIMPLEMENTED without that band visible in the frame, and no rendered robot may be presented as a physical robot stopping. Regeneration must be byte-identical, same discipline as F4 and F6.

Camera harness CODE is Tier 1 and runs nowhere by itself. RUNNING it against the physical Pi camera is a Tier 3 action under RESERVED-pi-deploy and needs per-session human authorization. Any capture involving a person is governed by the existing consent, PII and leakage rules already enforced by research/gesture-dataset/validate.py; that validator is the gate, not a new policy document. No capture of identifiable children. Real frames never upgrade a QIP requirement by themselves: QIP-R9.x stays UNIMPLEMENTED until the profile owner amends it under section 11.
